proof_body:
by
  intro a l x ha hx h
  have hne : ∀ n, a n * x ^ n ≠ 0 := fun n => mul_ne_zero (ha n) (pow_ne_zero n hx)
  have hr : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => |a (n + 1) * x ^ (n + 1)| / |a n * x ^ n|) Filter.atTop (nhds (l * |x|)) := by
    refine (h.mul_const |x|).congr fun n => ?_
    have h1 : |a n| ≠ 0 := abs_ne_zero.2 (ha n)
    have h2 : |x| ≠ 0 := abs_ne_zero.2 hx
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_pow, pow_succ]
    field_simp
  constructor
  · intro hl
    refine summable_of_ratio_test_tendsto_lt_one hl (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => abs_ne_zero.2 (hne n)) ?_
    simpa using hr
  · rintro hl ⟨s, hs⟩
    have h0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => a n * x ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have h2 := (hs.comp (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)).sub hs
      simp only [sub_self] at h2
      refine h2.congr fun n => ?_
      simp [Finset.sum_range_succ]
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 (hr.eventually (lt_mem_nhds hl))
    have hgrow : ∀ k, |a N * x ^ N| ≤ |a (N + k) * x ^ (N + k)| := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k ih =>
        have h3 := hN (N + k) (by omega)
        rw [one_lt_div (abs_pos.2 (hne (N + k)))] at h3
        exact ih.trans h3.le
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 h0 _ (abs_pos.2 (hne N))
    have h4 := hM (N + M) (by omega)
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at h4
    exact absurd h4 (not_lt.2 (hgrow M))
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (l x : ℝ), (∀ n, a n ≠ 0) → x ≠ 0 → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => |a (n + 1)| / |a n|) Filter.atTop (nhds l) → (l * |x| < 1 → Summable (fun n => |a n * x ^ n|)) ∧ (1 < l * |x| → ¬ ∃ s : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun K => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range K, a n * x ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds s))
